nodes.label: guidance/__init__.py
nodes.desc: Package entry: version 0.3.2, star-exports the library, and makes the module itself callable for the @guidance decorator.

nodes.label: @guidance decorator
nodes.desc: Turns plain Python functions into guidance functions; GuidanceFunction and GuidanceMethod intercept the Model argument and return state copies.

nodes.label: library exports
nodes.desc: Public surface: gen, select, string, capture, json, one_or_more, block, and the system/user/assistant role managers.

nodes.label: gen() / select()
nodes.desc: gen() requests constrained model output (max_tokens, regex, stop, temperature, tools); captured results land in lm[name].

nodes.label: roles: system/user/assistant
nodes.desc: Context managers that open and close chat roles, emitting RoleStart/RoleEnd nodes against the active chat template.

nodes.label: grammar builders
nodes.desc: Core builders string(), regex(), gen(), select(), repeat(), token_limit(), with_temperature(), capture(), subgrammar() that compose constraints.

nodes.label: GrammarNode AST
nodes.desc: The serialized node tree: LiteralNode, RegexNode, SelectNode, JoinNode, RepeatNode, RuleNode, SubgrammarNode, JsonNode plus role and media nodes.

nodes.label: Token/ByteParser
nodes.desc: Byte-level parser used to validate strings against a grammar offline and to fast-forward tokens the constraint already determines.

nodes.label: Model (lm += ...)
nodes.desc: Immutable Model object: __add__ copies state and applies nodes, stream() returns a lazy ModelStream, __getitem__ reads captures.

nodes.label: Interpreter protocol
nodes.desc: Abstract Interpreter that walks each ASTNode and yields OutputAttr events such as TextOutput, CaptureOutput, and Backtrack.

nodes.label: Engine + tokenizers
nodes.desc: Engine and EngineInterpreter implement grammar-driven token sampling: commit prefixes, constrain logits, and fast-forward forced bytes.

nodes.label: backends
nodes.desc: Concrete Model subclasses: Transformers, LlamaCpp, OpenAI, Mock, OnnxRuntimeGenAI, plus Azure AI Foundry factory functions.
